title: Halve sharp two-axis Gaussian rounding error and data additions
body:
A two-axis conservative Gaussian call currently uses four rounded pair kernels. This package replaces that block with an explicit lattice-coset map. It halves both the sharp worst-case block error, from `2 sqrt(2) h` to `sqrt(2) h`, and data additions, from 40 to 20. Half shifts remain eight. The new map is nearest on every input, preserves the complex sum and has an exact inverse without a rounding transcript.

The all-width call uses `5 N ceil(f/2)` additions and has error at most `ceil(f/2) h sqrt(N/2)`, compared with the retained stagewise `f h sqrt(N/2)` certificate. Both retained two-call and three-call ports run in their literal order and return both dirty banks exactly.

This changes the contract: global Gaussian phase covariance and the ideal square rewrite fail. The package gives exact counterexamples. There is no automatic selected-child substitution, physical Boolean/tape tariff, new kappa or selected-frontier change. None of the five framework assumptions is discharged.

Evidence: the written coset proof covers all integer inputs; 131,072 signed block cases check all 65,536 residues, the sharp old-error witness, inverse, sums and nearest error. Twelve complete calls, 336 spectator sums and twelve full dirty-port returns pass. Literal work, width guards and eight controls pass. Normal/optimized registered CPython 3.12, committed bytes/modes, official 16-file export with six source inputs, read-only Git-free empty-PATH replay and source-corruption rejection pass. Optional full-history validation was not run in the shallow checkout. Hosted CI and independent scientific review are separate.

Reproduce: `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fused-gaussian-rounding`.

Fresh base: canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8, selected PR6030. The full overlap cache covered 482 open PRs and 6,470 Discussion records; live handoffs and recent PRs were rechecked before submission. [Scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5475#discussioncomment-19365497). PR6532's randomized selected first MOVE is separate; this result is deterministic two-axis fusion. Search coverage is not a novelty certificate.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit PR6509 for the conservative pair kernel, explicit ports and matrix oracle; JoyboyBrian / PR5485 and the retained PR4743 lineage for the original ports. Exact bytes and source commit are retained in `inputs`, `SOURCES.json` and `ORIGINS.json`. The radix-four identity and lattice-coset method are classical. Apache-2.0.
